newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures close first day easier.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures close first day easier.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures ended a shortened first business day of the year weaker on Monday as profit-taking selling pressured the market, traders said.
Prices ranged from flat to 1.1 yen per kg lower. Benchmark June was down 1.0 yen from 1996's last trading day to 148.9 yen. Volume was 2,211 lots.

The market kicked off mixed and extended losses. "Despite the yen's weakness against the dollar, the upside may be limited as overseas markets are unlikely to rise sharply in the near-term amid a lack of significant buying by consuming countries," one trader said. --Tokyo Commodity Desk
